Enzymes work by finding alternate pathways with lower activation energies, as represented by the graph in Figure 18.18. It is customary in enzyme kinetics to refer to the activation energy as a free energy of activation, symbolized as G‡, and to identify the driving forces for enzyme-catalyzed reactions in terms of the enthalpies and entropies of activation, H‡ and S‡, as discussed in Section 18.6.
